description.zh: 文件的ID，您可以通过[ListFiles](~~173942~~)查询对应文件的ID。
description.en: The ID of the file. You can obtain the ID of the desired file by calling [ListFiles](~~173942~~).
The version of the file to query.

description.zh: DataWorks工作空间的ID，您可以单击页面右上角的小扳手图标，进入工作空间管理页面查看。
description.en: The ID of the DataWorks workspace. You can click the wrench icon in the upper-right corner of the page to go to the Workspace Management page and view it.

description.zh:
DataWorks工作空间的唯一标识符，即数据开发页面顶部切换工作空间处的英文标识。

该参数与ProjectId参数二者必须设置其一，以确定本次API调用操作的DataWorks工作空间。
description.en:
The unique identifier of the DataWorks workspace, which is the English identifier displayed at the top of the Data Development page when you switch workspaces.

You must specify either this parameter or the ProjectId parameter to identify the DataWorks workspace for this API call.

title.en: Obtain the details of a file version
